parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The region. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query regions.

*   If you do not specify a region, data in all regions is queried.
*   If you specify a region, data in the specified region is returned. You can specify one or more regions. Separate regions with commas (,).

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names that you want to query. Separate domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: HttpCode
parameters.description:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

*   **2xx**: HTTP 2xx status codes
*   **3xx**: HTTP 3xx status codes
*   **4xx**: HTTP 4xx status codes
*   **5xx**: HTTP 5xx status codes

If you do not specify an HTTP status code, data for all preceding HTTP status codes is queried.

parameters.name: IsOverseas
parameters.description:
Specify whether the region is outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

*   **1**: outside the Chinese mainland
*   **0**: inside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: ReportId
parameters.description: The ID of the operations report that you want to query. You can enter only one ID in each call. You can call the [DescribeDcdnSubList](~~270075~~) operation to query report IDs.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-report --domain-name www.example.com,www.example.org --report-id 2 --area shanghai --is-overseas 0 --http-code 2xx --start-time 2021-07-02T00:00:00Z --end-time 2021-07-02T01:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
